title: Animated Solar Irradiance Heat Maps on IfcOpenHouse4
description: Live daylight study on the IfcOpenHouse4 model: a synthetic sun arcs from sunrise to sunset, per-vertex Lambert irradiance is recomputed each tick, and the per-geometry heat-map textures are repainted in place. The renderer's atlas re-uploads only the affected sub-rects via texSubImage2D — no batch / mesh / material rebuild — so the southern facades light up in the morning, the gable shades the north wall after noon, and the surfaces darken into night without a single allocation in the hot path beyond the per-frame scalar arrays.
